title: EnableAI - Debug
content:
Member of: Debug Script Enables/disables AI processing in the game. Syntax: Function EnableAI(bool abEnable = true) native global debugOnly Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables AI processing, if false, disables it. Default: True Return Value: None Examples: ; Enables AI processing Debug.EnableAI()
; Disables AI processing Debug.EnableAI(false) See Also: - Debug Script - EnableDetection - Debug
